title: MC Unbound
description: This modpack "Recrafts" minecraft it makes it overall better while still keeping it fun and lightweight.
body: MC Crafted is a content-rich modpack that overhauls Minecraft while keeping the vanilla feel intact, offering something for every type of player — builders, adventurers, and PvPers alike. Exploration is massively expanded with worldgen mods like YUNG’s Better Strongholds, Better Dungeons, When Dungeons Arise, Structory, and Immersive Structures, while dimension overhauls such as End Remastered, Nether+, Deeper and Darker, and The Aether breathe new life into every realm. Combat feels more engaging with Better Combat, Expanded Combat, and epic bosses from L_Ender’s Cataclysm, while survival gets deeper thanks to mods like Farmer’s Delight, Sophisticated Storage, Traveler’s Backpack, and Create: Enchantment Industry. Builders have endless creative tools with Create, Create Deco, Supplementaries, Biomes O’ Plenty, and visual upgrades like Fresh Animations and Complementary Shaders Reimagined. To keep it all running smoothly, optimizations like FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, and Memory Leak Fix ensure better performance even with large modded worlds. Whether you want to craft, explore, fight, or build, MC Crafted delivers a massive yet balanced Minecraft experience that stays true to its vanilla roots while giving you countless new ways to play — all in both singleplayer and multiplayer.
